title: Seoul shares down over 2 pct late Tues. morning on AI concerns
caption:
South Korean markets tumbled over 2% as investors grew nervous about huge AI investments. Tech giants like Samsung and SK Hynix led the sell‑off, highlighting the market’s sensitivity to AI spending. The dip shows caution, not a verdict on AI’s future.

Source: En - Seoul shares down over 2 pct late Tues. morning on AI concerns
